title: Strait of Hormuz largely closed
text: Commercial transits through Hormuz have collapsed since the US-Israeli strikes on Iran on 28 February 2026. Gulf crude, LNG, LPG, products and fertiliser exports are disrupted; flows shown for 2024 are a pre-disruption baseline.
severityNote: Severity from the 28-day transits against the 2023 average: high when 60% or more below, medium when 25% or more below, otherwise low. Decided by Strait of Hormuz: 96% below.
derived: Commodities: at least 10% or 50 Mt of their seaborne trade has to cross Strait of Hormuz (Atlas estimate, 2024). Countries: for each of those commodities, the exporters and importers with at least 15% of its tonnage through the passage.

title: Red Sea diversions
text: Attacks on shipping near Bab el-Mandeb have diverted most Asia-Europe tanker, bulk and container traffic around the Cape of Good Hope since December 2023.
severityNote: Severity from the 28-day transits against the 2023 average: high when 60% or more below, medium when 25% or more below, otherwise low. Decided by Bab el-Mandeb: 64% below.
derived: Commodities: at least 10% or 50 Mt of their seaborne trade has to cross Bab el-Mandeb or Suez Canal (Atlas estimate, 2024). Countries: for each of those commodities, the exporters and importers with at least 15% of its tonnage through the passage.

title: Black Sea shipping under attack
text: Escalating attacks on ships and ports in the Black Sea affect grain, oilseed and crude (CPC) exports from Ukraine, Russia and Kazakhstan.
severityNote: Severity from the 28-day transits against the 2023 average: high when 60% or more below, medium when 25% or more below, otherwise low. Decided by Turkish Straits (Bosphorus and Dardanelles): 50% below.
derived: Commodities: at least 10% or 50 Mt of their seaborne trade has to cross Turkish Straits (Bosphorus and Dardanelles) (Atlas estimate, 2024). Countries: for each of those commodities, the exporters and importers with at least 15% of its tonnage through the passage.
